What it does

In practice Housecall Pro becomes the record for the entire job: the customer books, the technician receives the job on a phone, the invoice is generated on completion, and payment is collected before the van leaves. Its AI features target the tasks that quietly consume office hours — chasing review requests, following up quotes and answering routine questions.

Where the AI actually is

AI-assisted features for scheduling, review requests and customer messaging.

Pros

  • Covers the whole service job lifecycle
  • Strong mobile app for techs in the field
  • Large user base, so integrations are well supported

Cons

  • Costs add up as you add users and add-ons

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Landscapers in mind. Home service businesses that want one app covering booking through to payment.
